title: ID Balancing: Stable Training of Extremely Sparse MoE via PID-Based Load Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.39137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) via Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables massive parameter growth with nearly constant per-token computation. However, further scaling the parameter count requires increasingly sparse routing, where expert load imbalance becomes more severe. This imbalance reduces parameter utilization and training efficiency, and can undermine training stability, becoming a bottleneck to reliable scaling. In this work, we unify two representative auxiliary-loss-free methods as incomplete Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers: DeepSeek's loss-free method acts as a fixed-step integral controller, while Kimi K3's Quantile Balancing functions as a generalized proportional controller. Building on this control perspective, we propose ID Balancing, an Integral-Derivative controller. translated_title: ID平衡：基于PID负载控制实现极稀疏MoE的稳定训练
translated_abstract: 通过混合专家对大语言模型（LLM）进行扩展，能够在每token计算量近乎恒定的情况下实现参数量的大幅增长。然而，进一步扩大参数规模需要日益稀疏的路由，专家负载不均衡问题也随之加剧。这种不均衡降低了参数利用率和训练效率，并可能破坏训练稳定性，成为可靠扩展的瓶颈。在本工作中，我们将两种代表性的无辅助损失方法统一为不完整的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器：DeepSeek的无损方法相当于固定步长的积分控制器，而Kimi K3的分位数平衡则相当于广义的比例控制器。基于这一控制论视角，我们提出了ID平衡——一种积分-微分（ID）控制器。它根据负载误差对积分项进行缩放，并仅在不均衡恶化时激活微分项，从而实现更强的纠偏能力……
tldr: 该论文提出ID平衡方法，将现有无辅助损失负载均衡方法统一为不完整的PID控制器，并设计一种根据负载误差缩放积分项、仅在不均衡恶化时激活微分项的积分-微分控制器，从而实现极稀疏MoE的稳定训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ID Balancing, an Integral-Derivative controller that unifies existing auxiliary-loss-free load balancing methods as incomplete PID controllers, scaling its integral term with load error and activating its derivative term only when imbalance worsens, enabling stable training of extremely sparse MoE.
